# Harness Learning Guide

> Unofficial reading companion to Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation (Zhang et al., 2026), arXiv:2609.35738v1. All research credit belongs to the nine paper authors. No experiments or replication performed here.

## Read first
- [README](README.md): credit, scope, headline claims and reading routes.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): grounding, scope and editing rules.
- [Paper metadata](metadata/paper.json): exact version, authors, official links, provenance.
- [Source register](metadata/sources.json): primary-source checks.
- [Claim index](metadata/claims.json): findings, qualifications and source pages.

Preserve metric, population, failure treatment, and selection rules with numerical claims. Separate the paper's reported evidence from interpretation. This index follows an llms.txt-style navigation pattern; agent support for this convention is not guaranteed.
